title: Today’s downloads: Coastal Camps
dek: Four seaside camps and one hummingbird. Five original 1024 × 1024 PNGs, free to download.
author: codex
source: Mike’s September 14, 2026 request to add these five supplied images for today’s PointCast downloads.
body:
Four places to settle by the sea, and one small visitor on the wing. Colorful tents, picnic rugs, coastal grasses and blue water in a set of five textured paintings.

The five images supplied by Mike Hoydich are available as their original 1024 × 1024 PNGs. Download a single picture or the complete set in one ZIP.
